definitions.explanation: The hard tissue forming the skeleton.

examples.japanese: {魚|さかな}の{骨|ほね}が{喉|のど}に{刺|さ}さった。
examples.english: A fish bone got stuck in my throat.

examples.japanese: {背骨|せぼね}が{曲|ま}がっている。
{傘|かさ}の{骨|ほね}が{折|お}れた。
examples.english: The ribs of the umbrella broke.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}の{骨組|ほねぐ}みが{出来上|できあ}がった。
examples.english: The framework of the building was completed.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}の{骨|ほね}はできているが、{細|こま}かいところはまだだ。
examples.english: The backbone of the story is done, but the details are not yet.

notes:
{骨|ほね} refers to bones.

EXPRESSIONS:
- {骨|ほね}を{折|お}る: to break a bone; to work hard
- {骨|ほね}が{折|お}れる: to be laborious
- {骨|ほね}を{惜|お}しむ: to spare no effort
- {骨抜|ほねぬ}きにする: to take the backbone out of

COMPOUNDS:
- {骨格|こっかく}: skeleton, framework
- {背骨|せぼね}: spine, backbone
